rationale: Genome-wide GeCKO KO screen in HeLa with a circular-RNA m6A-GFP reporter: m6A on the reporter drives GFP translation, so knockouts of positive m6A regulators give low GFP (the paper: KO of METTL3 gave low GFP, and MAPK/RAS pathway genes were enriched in low-GFP cells). One High-GFP and one Low-GFP library were sequenced (one library per condition), so the no-replicate path is used and calls are screening-level. The contrast is low-GFP vs high-GFP; hits (m6A writers and the ERK/MAPK pathway, incl. USP5) are enriched in low-GFP (positive estimate). 994 dummyguide non-targeting controls. The series' m6A-seq/RNA-seq are a companion assay and not used.
